system.description:
Visionary scientists who broke from the Technocracy, keeping outdated and romantic technologies as the heart of their paradigm. Also called Etherites or the Sons of Ether.

Affiliation: Traditions
Affinity Spheres: Matter; Forces or Prime
system.focus: Science! – but imaginative, showy and gracefully futuristic, Science that can be seen, held and demonstrated. Etherites favour esoteric alchemy, craftwork, cybernetics, hypertech, reality hacking and weird science.
